Battery: optimized — Android may stop listening
Lock-screen alarm screen is not allowed
Optional: use another language from alphacephei.com/vosk/models. Used when you pick the imported-model phrase.

1. Settings → Apps → Find My Phone → Battery → choose “Unrestricted”.
2. Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → turn OFF “Put unused apps to sleep”, and make sure Find My Phone is not in “Sleeping apps” or “Deep sleeping apps”. Add it to “Never auto sleeping apps”.
3. Settings → Apps → Find My Phone → Permissions → Microphone → “Allow only while using the app” is enough because the listening service is started while the app is open; choose “Allow” if offered.
4. Settings → Notifications → App notifications → Find My Phone → allow all, including full-screen notifications.
5. Lock the app in Recents (tap its icon at the top of the card → “Keep open”).
6. After a reboot, open the app and tap Start Listening again (Android does not allow starting the microphone from the background after boot).
The green dot Android shows in the status bar confirms the microphone is active.
